knowledge.title: About GrowthsStack.Dev
knowledge.content: GrowthsStack.Dev is a personal portfolio and AI engineering brand focused on building intelligent software solutions. Services include AI chatbots, AI agents, SaaS applications, backend systems, automation platforms, API development, dashboard systems, growth automation, and social media automation. The goal is to help businesses automate operations and build scalable AI-powered products.

knowledge.title: Who is GrowthsStack.Dev
knowledge.content: GrowthsStack.Dev represents an AI Full Stack Engineer specializing in Python, FastAPI, Next.js, Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, OpenAI integrations, vector databases, backend architecture, AI automation, SaaS development, and intelligent business systems.

knowledge.title: Experience
knowledge.content: GrowthsStack.Dev has more than four years of experience building AI systems, backend platforms, SaaS products, automation workflows, REST APIs, and enterprise software.

knowledge.title: Projects
knowledge.content: More than thirty-five software projects have been completed including AI chatbots, AI agents, automation systems, resume analyzers, dashboards, SaaS applications, backend systems, and custom APIs.

knowledge.title: AI Systems
knowledge.content: More than twenty AI-powered systems have been deployed including automation platforms, AI assistants, business tools, backend APIs, and intelligent workflow systems.

knowledge.title: Mission
knowledge.content: The mission is to help startups, businesses, agencies, healthcare companies, and enterprises leverage AI and automation to improve productivity, reduce manual work, and scale efficiently.
